title: Malaysian Government's Detention of Greek Vessel Pireas and Crew
what_it_is: Malaysian Government's Detention of Greek Vessel Pireas and Crew

sections.label: Pireas and Polaris collision
sections.summary: A Greece-registered bulk carrier collided with a Malaysian government vessel in Singapore Territorial Waters off Tuas, and MPA found it was not a very serious marine casualty.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: On 9 February this year, the Greece-registered bulk carrier Pireas collided with the Malaysian government vessel Polaris in Singapore Territorial Waters off Tuas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: A Singapore Police Coast Guard vessel was onsite, observed and recorded the collision.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: MPA ascertained that this incident was not classified as a "very serious marine casualty" under the International Maritime Organization (IMO) Marine Casualty Investigation Code.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Pireas was not detained by the Malaysian authorities in Singapore Territorial Waters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will not allow foreign government vessels to assert any authority in our waters.

sections.label: Singapore Port Limits instructions
sections.summary: These waters are designated Singapore Port Limits, so passing vessels should take instructions from MPA, and foreign government vessels have no locus standi to issue instructions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: In fact, these have now been designated Singapore Port Limits.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: All vessels which are passing or transiting through these waters should, therefore, take instructions from the MPA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: Any foreign government vessels have no locus standi to be issuing any instructions.
